titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Abraham to David: the Line of Kings (ch. 13–16)
part: ch. 13–16 — Abraham to David: the Line of Kings
source: Carl Bezold, Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige (Munich, 1905), ch. 13–16 — public domain. Geʿez text as in Ran HaCohen's Unicode edition of Bezold (tau.ac.il/~hacohen/KN, from Michal Jerabek's 1995 digitization), archived and checked against Bezold's printed page. Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Abram refuses his father's idols and is called by the one God, is renamed Abraham, and leaves for Salem; the covenant promise includes the coming of the Ark. The kingship then passes from Isaac and Jacob to Judah, since Reuben, the firstborn, forfeits it, and runs down through Perez and the genealogy to David.

sentences.l: And-he-begot Terah a-son, and-he-named-him Abram;
sentences.i: Terah begot a son, and named him Abram;
sentences.n: ወ- 'and' opens almost every unit; I will not repeat that. ወለደ 'he begot' is a simple perfect (3ms); ታራ Terah is the subject, ወልደ 'a son' the object (accusative ending -ä). ወሰመዮ = ወ + ሰመየ 'he named' + -o 'him'. UNCERTAIN: the clause order 'begot Terah a son, and named him Abram' reads a little abruptly, and who does the naming is only implied (Terah). I take it as printed; Genesis 11:26 names Terah's sons, and the Kebra Nagast simply compresses it.

sentences.l: And-when was to-him 12 years, sent-him his-father Terah that he-sell idols;
sentences.i: And when he was twelve years old, his father Terah sent him to sell idols;
sentences.n: ሶበ 'when'. ኮነ ሎቱ 'was to him' is the Geʿez way to say 'he had / he was' (ሎቱ = ለ- + -ቱ 'to him'); ፲ወ፪ ዓመተ '12 years' (10 and 2), the noun in the accusative -ä. ለአኮ is read as ለአከ 'he sent' + -o 'him' (root l-ʾ-k; the spelling ለአኮ is read as ለአከ + -o, UNCERTAIN but fits the sense). ከመ ይሢጥ 'that he sell': ከመ + the subjunctive (ይሢጥ, 3ms) expresses purpose. This ከመ + subjunctive pattern recurs constantly. ጣዖት 'idol' (I do not know the word's origin).

sentences.l: And-said Abram: 'This indeed is-not a-god that-saves';
sentences.i: and Abram said, 'This is no god that saves';
sentences.n: ይቤ 'he said' (defective verb, ይቤሎ 'he said to him', ይቤሎሙ 'he said to them'). ኢኮነ 'is not / was not' (ኢ- negation + ኮነ). ዘያድኅን = ዘ- 'which, who' + ያድኅን 'he saves' (causative አድኅነ). ዝሰ is ዝ 'this' (the short masculine demonstrative, used alongside ዝንቱ) + the contrastive enclitic -ሰ ('this one, for its part'); l shows the -ሰ as 'indeed' and i leaves its force light. -ሰ is a particle you will see again (አንተሰ, መንግሥትሰ).

sentences.l: And-he-said-to-them to-those who he-sells to-them: 'Is-it (so) that-what you-buy, which-not saves, (is) a-god — wood and-stone and-iron and-bronze(?) — that made-it the-hand-of the-craftsman(?);
sentences.i: And he said to those to whom he sold, 'Is what you buy, which cannot save, a god — wood and stone and iron and bronze — which a craftsman's hand made?
sentences.n: ለእለ ይሠይጥ ሎሙ 'to those to whom he sells (to them)': እለ 'those who' is the plural relative, and the resumptive ሎሙ 'to them' repeats it, as Geʿez often does. ቦኑ = ቦ 'is there' + -ኑ (question particle): 'is it so that…?', here a rhetorical question. ዘትሣየጡ 'which you buy' (root ś-y-ṭ, as in ይሠይጥ above and ተሣይጦ below). The list ዕፅ ወእብን ወኀጺን ወብርት: ዕፅ wood, እብን stone, ኀጺን iron; ብርት I take as 'bronze', as in ch. 9–12 (ወብርት); the exact metal is uncertain without Dillmann. ዘገብሮ እደ ኬንያ: ገብሮ 'made it'; ኬንያ is the craftsman/fashioner word (the same noun as ወኬንያሃ 'her fashioner' in ch. 1); እደ is the construct of the singular እድ 'hand' (plural እደው, as in ch. 13's ሰፍሐ እደዊሁ), so 'the hand of a craftsman' agrees with the singular verb ገብሮ; the -o 'it' is resumptive for ዘ. Echoes the prophetic polemic against idols (Psalm 115:4; Isaiah 44).

sentences.l: And-they-refused-him buying from-Abram, because he-himself had-defiled the-carved-images-of his-father; and-while he-was-bringing-them-in he-turned-aside from-the-road and-set-them and-looked-at-them and-said to-them:
sentences.i: But they refused to buy from Abram, because he himself had defiled his father's carved images; and while he was bringing them in, he turned off the road, set them down, looked at them, and said to them,
sentences.n: UNCERTAIN, several points. ወአበይዎ ተሣይጦ ለአብራም: አበይዎ is the 3rd plural perfect አበዩ 'they refused' + -o 'him', with the infinitive ተሣይጦ 'buying'; ለአብራም either repeats the -o ('him, Abram') or gives 'from Abram'. The verb is plural, so the buyers are the subject: 'they refused to buy from Abram'. ለግልፈዋተ: ለ- marks the object again after the verb with -ሙ. ለሊሁ 'he himself' (emphatic). አርኰሶሙ ለግልፈዋተ: አርኰሰ 'defile, dishonour' (the verb of ch. 16, used of Reuben); ግልፈዋት is plural of a word for carved images (ግልፍ 'carved/graven') — the exact word is not certain to me. ያአትዎሙ 'he brings them in' (አአተወ, causative of አተወ 'enter'), after እንዘ 'while'. ተግሕሠ 'he turned aside'. Sequence of perfects: አንበሮሙ 'he set them', ነጸሮሙ 'he looked at them'.

sentences.l: And-there-was-not (one) who they-answered-him, for stones and-trees they;
sentences.i: But no one answered him, for they were stones and trees.
sentences.n: አልቦ 'there is not / there was no one' (አል- 'not' + ቦ 'there is'). ዘአውሥእዎ 'who answered him' (አውሥአ 'answer'): the verb is 3rd plural, 'they answered him', so the clause is impersonal, 'there was none who they answered him', that is, no one answered him. Plurals: አእባን 'stones' (from እብን), ዕፀው 'trees, wood' (from ዕፅ) — 'broken' plurals made by changing the internal vowel pattern, common in Geʿez. እሙንቱ 'they' (masc. pl.).

sentences.i: 'If you cannot save yourselves from the one who strikes you, and cannot pay back the one who harms you, in what sense are you called gods?
sentences.n: እመሰ 'if indeed' (እመ 'if' + -ሰ). ርእስክሙ 'your heads' = idiomatic 'yourselves' (ርእስ 'head' is the Geʿez reflexive). ገፍዐ 'strike, oppress'. UNCERTAIN: ታሐሥሙ / አሕሠመ — both seem to come from one root (ḥ-ś-m, a verb of harming), so the sense would be 'you do not harm him who harmed you', that is, you cannot pay back; I cannot check the root. በአይቴ 'by what / how' (lit. 'in where'). ትሰመዩ 'you are called' (passive of ሰመየ), with a second accusative አማልክተ 'gods' (plural of አምላክ).

sentences.l: 'As-for-my-god, be-to-me you, O-Lord, creator-of heavens and-earth, creator-of sun and-moon, creator-of sea and-dry-land, maker-of adornment-of heaven and-earth, that-which appears and-that-which not-appears, maker-of all; be-to-me my-god. And-you I-believed-in; and-another-indeed there-is-not-to-me in-whom-I-believe, apart-from-you, from-today.' And-then appeared-to-him a-chariot of-fire which burns; and-feared Abram, and-fell on-his-face to the-ground;
sentences.i: 'As for my God — be my God, you, O Lord, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Creator of sun and moon, Creator of sea and dry land, Maker of the adornment of heaven and earth, of what is seen and what is unseen, Maker of all; be my God. In you I have believed, and I have no other in whom to believe besides you, from this day.' And after this a chariot of fire, blazing, appeared to him; and Abram was afraid and fell with his face to the ground;
sentences.n: A prayer made of construct chains, the book's favourite pattern: ፈጣሬ ሰማያት 'creator-of heavens', ፈጣሬ ፀሐይ 'creator-of sun', ገባሬ ሰርጐ ሰማይ 'maker-of adornment-of heaven'. The head noun ends in -ä (ፈጣሬ, ገባሬ), the construct/accusative form, and the next noun follows without a linking word. Here they are in direct address, so 'O Creator of…'. እግዚኦ is እግዚእ 'lord' + the vocative -ኦ, 'O Lord'. ኩነኒ 'be to me' (imperative ኩን + -ኒ). ሰርጕ 'adornment, ordering' — the sense 'ornament' is my reading; UNCERTAIN. ዘያስተርኢ ወዘኢያስተርኢ 'what appears and what does not' (visible and invisible; cf. the creed, Colossians 1:16). ኪያከ ተአመንኩ: ኪያከ is the object form 'you' ('it is you whom'), ተአመነ 'believe' takes the accusative here. ባዕደሰ አልብየ 'as for another, I have not' (ባዕድ 'other'); ዘእትአመን 'in whom I might believe' (subjunctive). ዘእንበሌከ 'apart from you'. አስተርአዮ = አስተርአየ 'he appeared, showed himself' (the Ct stem of ርእየ, the same stem as ያስተርኢ above) + -o 'to him'; ሰረገላ 'chariot' (cf. 2 Kings 2:11); ፈርሀ 'he feared'.

sentences.l: 'Do-not-fear from-today; my-servant you; and-I-will-establish my-covenant with-you and-with your-seed after-you, and-I-will-multiply your-seed and-I-will-make-great your-name exceedingly; and-I-will-bring-down her, the-ark-of my-covenant, upon earth in 7 generation(s) after-you, and-she-will-walk with your-seed; and-you-will-be saviour for-your-kin;
sentences.i: 'Do not be afraid from this day: you are my servant. I will establish my covenant with you and with your seed after you; I will multiply your seed and make your name very great. And I will bring down the Ark of my covenant upon the earth in seven generations after you, and it will go about with your seed; and you will be a saviour for your kin.
sentences.n: Echoes Genesis 12:2 and 15–17 (covenant, seed, great name). ኣ- (for እ-) on ኣቀውም 'I will establish', ኣበዝኅ 'I will multiply', ኣዐቢ 'I will make great', ኣወርዳ 'I will bring her down' is the 1sg prefix; the verbs are subjunctive used as a future. ኣወርዳ ለታቦተ: the object suffix -ā 'her' (merged into the final -ዳ) anticipates the noun, 'I will bring her down, the ark-of…'. ታቦት is feminine, hence ታንሶሱ 'she will go about' (3fs). UNCERTAIN: ታንሶሱ and ትከውን are each both 3rd feminine ('she', the Ark) and 2nd masculine ('you'); I take the first as the Ark (it goes about with your seed after you) and the second as Abraham ('you will be a saviour'), but the text does not mark the change of subject, and 'she (the Ark) will be a saviour for your kin' is possible. This is the central claim of the book: the Ark of the covenant comes to dwell on earth with Abraham's line. በ፯ ትውልድ: 'in 7 generation' — whether 'in the seventh generation' or 'after seven generations' is left open by the grammar; ፯ is a cardinal, not an ordinal, so I translate 'in seven generations'. መድኀኒተ 'saviour' (accusative as predicate); ዘመድ 'kin'.

sentences.i: After him, Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, transgressed the commandment of God, and the kingdom passed from him and from his seed, because he defiled his father's wife; for it was not right to transgress the law that God had commanded.
sentences.n: በኰሩ ለያዕቆብ 'his firstborn, Jacob's' (the suffix + ለ- genitive again). ተዐደወ ትእዛዘ 'he transgressed the commandment' — ተዐደወ takes the accusative directly here (elsewhere እም- 'away from'). ፈለሰት 'it moved, passed' is feminine, agreeing with መንግሥት 'kingdom'. Genesis 35:22 and 49:3–4 (Reuben loses the firstborn's rights). ዘአርኰሰ ብእሲተ አቡሁ 'that he defiled the wife of his father'; በእንተ ዘ- 'because of the fact that'. ኢርቱዕ 'not right' (ኢ- + ርቱዕ 'straight, right'), the predicate of a nominal clause. ተዐድዎ I read as the verbal noun of ተዐደወ, 'the transgressing' (compare ተዐዲዎ ማሕላ in ch. 11, and ተሣይጦ in ch. 13): 'it was not right to transgress the law'. UNCERTAIN: the same letters could also be a perfect with -o ('they transgressed it'), but the ch. 11 parallel favours the verbal noun. ዘአዘዘ እግዚኣብሔር 'which commanded God': verb before subject.

glossary.ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity')
glossary.ለዘ: ዘ — (to/of the one) whom (ለ- + relative pronoun; ወቦ ለዘ 'and there is one whom')
glossary.ለዘመድከ: ዘመድ — for your kin (ለ- + noun + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.ለዘርእከ: ዘርእ — to your seed (ለ- 'to' + noun + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.ለግልፈዋተ: ግልፈት — carved images (ለ- marking the object + noun, plural ግልፈዋት; the singular and the exact sense are uncertain)
glossary.ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
glossary.ሎሙ: ለ — to them (preposition ለ- with 3mp suffix: ሎሙ)
glossary.ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
glossary.መድኀኒተ: መድኀኒት — salvation, saviour (noun; accusative predicate: 'you will be a salvation', i.e. a saviour)
glossary.ምድረ: ምድር — land, earth (noun, f.; construct 'land of' / accusative)
glossary.ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died'
glossary.ረገፆ: ረገጸ — he kicked him (3ms perfect, r-g-ṣ + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ሳላ: ሳላ — Shelah (Sala) (proper name) · in the Davidic line (ch. 16) the Salmon of Ruth 4:20 and Matthew 1:4–5, whom Luke 3:32 calls Sala; a different person from Shelah
glossary.ቅድሜሁ: ቅድመ — before him (preposition ቅድመ in its form ቅድሜ- + -hu 'him')
glossary.በነፍሱ: ነፍስ — in his soul, self (በ- + noun + -u 'his')
glossary.በአእባን: እብን — with stones (በ- + noun, plural አእባን)
glossary.በአይቴ: አይቴ — by what, in what (በ- + interrogative 'where, what')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
glossary.በኰሩ: በኵር — his firstborn (noun + -u 'his'; ሮቤል በኰሩ ለያዕቆብ 'Reuben, his firstborn, Jacob's')
glossary.በዝጋናተ: ዝጋና — with collars, neck-chains (በ- + noun, plural; uncertain)
glossary.በ፯: ፯ — in 7, spoken በሰብዐቱ (bä-säbʿätu) 'in seven' (በ- + cardinal numeral; ፯ ትውልድ 'in seven generations', not an ordinal 'seventh')
glossary.ባረኮ: ባረከ — he blessed him (3ms perfect, b-r-k + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ቦኑ: ቦ — is there? is it so that? (existential ቦ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.ተሀይደ: ተሀይደ — he/it was taken away (3ms perfect passive; uncertain stem)
glossary.ተሣይጦ: ተሣየጠ — to buy, buying (verbal noun of ተሣየጠ, 'buy from')
glossary.ተሰምየ: ተሰምየ — he was named, called (3ms perfect passive of ሰመየ)
glossary.ተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — he transgressed, overstepped (3ms perfect, tä-ʿädäwä)
glossary.ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
glossary.ተግሕሠ: ተግሕሠ — he turned aside (3ms perfect, tä-g-ḥ-ś; uncertain stem)
glossary.ትሰመዩ: ተሰምየ — you are called (2mp imperfect, passive of ሰመየ)
glossary.ትክሉ: ክህለ — you are able (2mp imperfect, k-h-l)
glossary.ኀየሰ: ኀየሰ — he excelled, was good (3ms perfect, ḫ-y-s)
glossary.ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
glossary.አልብየ: አልቦ — I have not (negative existential አልቦ + -ya '1s')
glossary.አሕሠመ: አሕሠመ — he harmed, did evil to (3ms perfect, causative, ḥ-ś-m)
glossary.አማልክተ: አምላክ — gods (noun; plural አማልክት, accusative form)
glossary.አምላኪየሰ: አምላክ — as for my god (noun + -ya '1s my' + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.አርኰሶሙ: አርኰሰ — he defiled them (3ms perfect, causative, r-k-s + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.አስተሐቀርኩክሙ: አስተሐቀረ — I despised, I despise you (1s perfect, Ct stem ʾastä-, ḥ-q-r, + -ክሙ 'you pl.')
glossary.አስተርአዮ: አስተርአየ — it appeared to him (3ms perfect + -ዮ 'to him')
glossary.አስትዩኒ: አስተየ — give me to drink (2mp imperative, causative of ሰትየ 'drink', + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
glossary.አብልዑኒ: አብልዐ — feed me (2mp imperative, causative of በልዐ 'eat', + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.አዕረፈ: አዕረፈ — he rested, died, reposed (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, r-f)
glossary.አዝማዲከ: ዘመድ — your kinsmen (noun, plural አዝማድ + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.አጥረየ: አጥረየ — he acquired (3ms perfect, causative, ṭ-r-y)
glossary.ኢተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — he did not transgress (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, tä-ʿädäwä)
glossary.ኢታድኅኑ: አድኀነ — you do not save (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp imperfect, causative, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ኢትፍራህ: ፈርሀ — do not fear (ኢ- + 2ms jussive, f-r-h)
glossary.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
glossary.ኢያስሕቱከ: አስሐተ — lest they lead you astray (ከመ ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative, s-ḥ-t + -ka '2ms')
glossary.ኢይትመየጥ: ተመይጠ — not turning back (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, tämäyyäṭä)
glossary.እምአኀዊሁ: አኅ — than his brothers (እም- comparative + noun, plural አኀው + -hu 'his')
glossary.እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun)
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun)
glossary.እምዛቲ: ዛቲ — from this (እም- 'from' + feminine demonstrative ዛቲ)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
glossary.እፌኑ: ፈነወ — I will send (1s imperfect, f-n-w)
glossary.ኩነኒ: ኮነ — be to me (2ms imperative, k-w-n + -ኒ 'to me')
glossary.ኬንያ: ኬንያ — craftsman, maker (noun; uncertain, sense from context)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun; construct 'son of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደ ታራ ወልደ 'Terah begot a son'; ch. 13)
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወመነነ: መነነ — and he renounced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, m-n-n)
glossary.ወመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — and the kingdom (ወ- + noun; accusative)
glossary.ወመንግሥትሰ: መንግሥት — and as for the kingdom (ወ- + noun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወምሁራነ: ምሁር — and trained, learned (ወ- + adjective, plural ምሁራን accusative)
glossary.ወሠነየ: ሠነየ — and it was fair, good (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ś-n-y)
glossary.ወረገሞ: ረገመ — and he cursed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, r-g-m + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወሰመንተ: ሰመንቱ — and eight (ወ- + numeral; accusative ሰመንተ)
glossary.ወሰመዮ: ሰመየ — and he named him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-m-y + -ዮ 'him')
glossary.ወሰበሮ: ሰበረ — and he broke him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, s-b-r + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወሰፍሐ: ሰፍሐ — and he spread out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወበሥጋሁ: ሥጋ — and in his body (ወ- + በ- + noun + -hu 'his')
glossary.ወበርትዕ: ርትዕ — and in uprightness (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበየውሀት: የውሀት — and in simplicity (ወ- + በ- + noun 'simplicity, guilelessness')
glossary.ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ወባረኮ: ባረከ — and he blessed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወባዕደሰ: ባዕድ — and another indeed (ወ- + adjective 'other', accusative + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወቦሙ: በ — and with them (ወ- + preposition በ- 'with, by' + 3mp suffix -ሙ: ቦሙ)
glossary.ወተለዐለ: ተለዐለ — and he was exalted (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-läʿälä)
glossary.ወተምዖ: ተምዐ — and he was angry with him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tämʿä + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወተሞገሰ: ተሞገሰ — and he was esteemed, praised (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tämogäsä)
glossary.ወተባረከ: ባረከ — and he was blessed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive-reflexive ተ- stem of ባረከ, b-r-k)
glossary.ወተባረኩ: ባረከ — and they were blessed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, passive-reflexive ተ- stem of ባረከ, b-r-k)
glossary.ወተናገሮ: ተናገረ — and he spoke with him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem, n-g-r; + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወተአዘዘ: ተአዘዘ — and he obeyed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-ʾazzäzä; takes ለ-)
glossary.ወታንሶሱ: አንሶሰወ — and she will walk about (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, quadriliteral አንሶሰወ, as in the published ታንሶሱ; the Ark is feminine; the same letters could be 2ms 'you', see the unit note)
glossary.ወትከውን: ኮነ — and you will be (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, k-w-n; the same letters could be 3fs 'she', see the unit note)
glossary.ወኀየሰ: ኀየሰ — and he excelled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ḫ-y-s)
glossary.ወኀደረ: ኀደረ — and he dwelt (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ḫ-d-r)
glossary.ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወነግሠ: ነግሠ — and he reigned (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
glossary.ወነጸሮሙ: ነጸረ — and he looked at them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ṣ-r + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአርአየ: አርአየ — and he turned, showed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, r-ʾ-y; ወአርአየ ገጾ 'and he turned his face')
glossary.ወአበዩ: አበየ — and they refused (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-b-y)
glossary.ወአበይዎ: አበየ — and they refused him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-b-y + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወአብርሃምኒ: አብርሃም — and Abraham, for his part (ወ- + name + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወአንሥኦ: አንሥአ — and he raised him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦ 'him'; subject not stated)
glossary.ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንበሮሙ: አንበረ — and he set them down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, n-b-r + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአእተተ: አእተተ — and he removed, took away (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአዕረፈ: አዕረፈ — and he rested, died (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, ʾ-ʿ-r-f)
glossary.ወአዝማዲሁ: ዘመድ — and his kinsmen (ወ- + noun, plural አዝማድ + -hu 'his')
glossary.ወኢተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — and he did not transgress (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ወኢታሐሥሙ: አሕሠመ — and you do not requite, do not harm in return (ወ- + ኢ- + 2mp imperfect of አሕሠመ 'harm'; the stem of ታሐሥሙ is uncertain, sense from context)
glossary.ወኢትኩኑኒ: ኮነ — and do not be to me (ወ- + ኢ- prohibition + 2mp jussive, k-w-n + -ኒ 'to me')
glossary.ወኢነበብዎ: ነበበ — and they did not speak to him (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, n-b-b + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወኣቀውም: አቀመ — and I will establish (ወ- + 1s imperfect, causative, q-w-m)
glossary.ወኣበዝኅ: አበዝኀ — and I will multiply (ወ- + 1s imperfect, causative, b-z-ḫ)
glossary.ወኣወርዳ: አወረደ — and I will bring her down (ወ- 'and' + 1s imperfect, causative አ- stem of ወረደ, w-r-d; + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወኣዐቢ: አዐበየ — and I will make great (ወ- + 1s imperfect, causative, ʿ-b-y)
glossary.ወእሁቦሙ: ወሀበ — and I will give them (ወ- + 1s imperfect, w-h-b + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወእም: እም — and from (ወ- 'and' + preposition; here with the next word, ወእም ድኅረ 'and after')
glossary.ወእምዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and from his seed (ወ- + እም- + noun + -u 'his')
glossary.ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
glossary.ወከብረ: ከብረ — and he became glorious (ወ- + 3ms perfect, k-b-r)
glossary.ወኪያከ: ኪያ — and you (ወ- + object pronoun ኪያ + -ka '2ms')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
glossary.ወወሰደ: ወሰደ — and he took away (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-s-d)
glossary.ወወድቀ: ወድቀ — and he fell (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-d-q)
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወዕቡቃነ: ዕቡቅ — and contemptible (?) (ወ- + adjective, plural accusative; uncertain)
glossary.ወዕፀው: ዕፅ — and trees (ወ- + noun, plural ዕፀው)
glossary.ወዘኢያስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — and that which does not appear (ወ- + ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ወየዐንቁ: ዐነቀ — and they put collars round their necks (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, ʿ-n-q; uncertain sense)
glossary.ወይቀንቱ: ቀነተ — and they gird (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, q-n-t)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይትቄጸሉ: ተቄጸለ — and they are crowned (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, passive/reflexive of ቄጸለ, 'crown oneself')
glossary.ወደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — and his children, sons (ወ- + noun + -u 'his')
glossary.ወገሮ: ወገረ — he pelted him, threw (stones) at him (3ms perfect, w-g-r + -ኦ 'him'; the initial ወ is a root letter, not 'and')
glossary.ወጸዐሎሙ: ጸዐለ — and he was angry with them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ṣ-ʿ-l + -ሎሙ 'at them'; root and sense uncertain)
glossary.ወፀረፈ: ፀረፈ — and he reviled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ṣ-r-f)
glossary.ወፈለሰት: ፈለሰ — and she passed, moved away (ወ- + 3fs perfect, f-l-s; subject መንግሥት)
glossary.ወፈርሀ: ፈርሀ — and he feared (ወ- + 3ms perfect, f-r-h)
glossary.ዘትሣየጡ: ሣየጠ — which you buy (ዘ- relative + 2mp imperfect, ś-y-ṭ)
glossary.ዘትክሉ: ክህለ — that you are able (ዘ- + 2mp imperfect, k-h-l)
glossary.ዘአርኰሰ: አርኰሰ — (because of what) he defiled (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative, r-k-s)
glossary.ዘአውሥእዎ: አውሥአ — that they answered him (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, causative, w-ś-ʾ + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ዘአዘዘ: አዘዘ — which he commanded (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘኢያድኅን: አድኀነ — which does not save (ዘ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, causative, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ዘኣርእየከ: አርአየ — which I will show you (ዘ- relative + 1s imperfect, causative, r-ʾ-y + -ka '2ms')
glossary.ዘእሴአለክሙ: ሰአለ — what I ask of you (ዘ- relative + 1s imperfect, s-ʾ-l + -ክሙ 'you pl.')
glossary.ዘእቤ: ብህለ — which I speak of, say (ዘ- relative + 1s imperfect እቤ, b-h-l)
glossary.ዘእትአመን: ተአምነ — in whom I believe (ዘ- relative + 1s imperfect)
glossary.ዘእንበሌከ: እንበለ — apart from you, besides you (ዘ- + preposition እንበለ + -ka '2ms')
glossary.ዘያድኅን: አድኀነ — that saves (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ዘይንእስ: ንእሰ — who is younger, small (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, n-ʾ-s)
glossary.ዘገብሮ: ገብረ — which made it (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'it')
glossary.ያመልኩክሙ: አምለከ — who worship you (3mp imperfect + -ክሙ 'you pl.')
glossary.ያአትዎሙ: አአተወ — he brings them in (3ms imperfect, causative of አተወ, + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ይመውእ: መውአ — he overcomes, defeats (3ms imperfect, m-w-ʾ)
glossary.ይሢጥ: ሠይጠ — that he sell (3ms subjunctive after ከመ, ś-y-ṭ)
glossary.ይትባረክ: ባረከ — that he be blessed (3ms subjunctive after ከመ, passive-reflexive ተ- stem of ባረከ, b-r-k)
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n)
glossary.ዲባጋተ: ዲባግ — brocade, fine garment (noun, plural accusative; uncertain)
glossary.ገቢረ: ገብረ — to do, doing (infinitive/verbal noun of ገብረ, accusative)
glossary.ገፍዐክሙ: ገፍዐ — he struck/harmed you (3ms perfect, g-f-ʿ + -ክሙ 'you pl.')
glossary.ጸፍዖ: ጸፍዐ — he slapped him (3ms perfect, ṣ-f-ʿ + -ኦ 'him')
